main_text.p: Thrasonum more in calicibus, in patellis, in parietibus, in fenestris pingere & traducere velimus. Viget eorum memoria in coelo, ubi sub altari animæ martyrorum propter verbum Dei, & propter testimonium, quod tuebantur, clamant voce magna, dicentes: Usquequo Domine, qui sanctus es & verax, non judicas, et sanguinem nostrum vindicas, eum reposcendo abs, qui habitant in terra? Apoc. 6.10. Sic de sanctis nostris gloriari liberet, possemus verius, quam vos de Francisco vestro stigmatizato, de Dominico, de Georgio Cappadoce, homine hæretico, improbo, Arriano; qui quum ab ethnicis sub Juliano apostata crudeliter interfectus, cadaver ejus combustum est, & cineres ejus in mare projecti, ut est apud Ammianum Marcell. lib. 22. de Catharina vestra, quæ Cofti regis filia dicitur, à vobis colitur; de Chriftophoro homine giganteo, contra omnem fidem ac veritatem veteris historiæ gloriamini. Verum gloria nostra Deus est. Tandem falsos ecclesiasticos producis. Quare habent illi canonem sanctorum vestrorum. Miseria nova. Potestas illa canonis ignota fuit patribus usque ad annum Christi 880, quando Adrianus sibi hoc jus usurpavit. Quod etiam Alexander tertius postea c. 1. extrav. de reliquiis sanctorum confirmavit. Interim fasti ecclesiastici notant nomina apostolorum, à quorum
main_text.notes: Printed page 166, single column. Several words are in a faded or uneven impression and are read with some uncertainty, notably "Thrasonum" (first line, possibly "Thraso-num" or "Thrasonum"), "sanctorum" and "sanctis" in the Latin passage. Words "quum" and "quorum" are read from a faded line; the final word "quorum" is also the catchword. Lines with heavy show-through and staining were transcribed from the clearest visible letters; some words in the lower-left margin area of the Apocalypse citation may be inaccurate. Several passages are partly illegible at the top-right and near the centre of the page; where the scan is too faint to read letter by letter, the reading above is a best estimate and should be checked against the original.
